messages.subject: Sample Size in gdistsamp Analysis
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am using the function gdistsamp to model the density of grassland birds and use the function modavgPred to get predicted density estimates and unconditional standard errors for each combination (Grazing, Planting Practice, and Year) of my field treatments. To correctly graph a specific treatment (for example Grazing) I need to create an average standard error for my grazed and ungrazed fields by calculating the pooled variance and taking the square root of the pooled variance. To calculate the pooled variance I need to know the sample size. I am assuming that my sample size when using gdistsamp would be the number of detections in a treatment and not the number of fields that are in a treatment. Am I correct in assuming that? Just looking for some clarification.

Thanks,
Ben Wilson
